title: POST /payments/process/guest
$comment: cardData has the shape of a saved card (schemas/payments/save.json). Its own cardData is Evervault ciphertext: either one ev: value (what the relay produces) or the JSON of evervault.encrypt({ number, cvc, expiry }), which PaymentWidget.tsx sends; the handler checks that every value in that JSON is ciphertext, which a pattern cannot (pci-remediation-plan.md F6 step 4). amount is in the currency's major unit. userId is optional: a signed-in user pays as themselves, and a merchant's key must name one of its own users, which the handler checks (pci-remediation-plan.md F3).

currency.$comment: The fiat currency charged, an ISO 4217 code
